**Orbweaver 1.0.4 can update itself, can run slash commands in sessions on your other machines, and stops quiet remote sessions from disappearing.** It also has a new logo, and it fixes several ways the link between your machines could stall or drop.

## What's new

- **Orbweaver updates itself.** It checks GitHub for a newer release when it starts and once a day after that. When it finds one, it shows a notice with **Install & restart**, **Later** and **Skip**. Nothing installs until you click. The download has to match its published checksum. On macOS the new app must also be signed by Uplift Foundation and notarized by Apple, or it is refused. On macOS the old app is swapped for the new one in a single step, so a crash halfway through can't leave you with no Orbweaver installed. On Windows, Setup runs silently and reopens the app when it finishes. You can also check by hand from the tray menu, and you can turn on pre-releases in **Settings → Updates**.
- **Slash commands work in remote sessions.** Typing a `/command` in the chat panel of a session on another machine, or of a background job or a Claude Desktop session, now runs it. Before, it was sent as plain text. Commands that can't run in that kind of session are left out of the list instead of failing after you send them. This is on by default. To turn it off, use **Settings → Remote Control commands → Run slash commands in background jobs and Desktop sessions**. If the CLI rejects a command, the panel tells you which CLI version rejected it.
- **Quiet remote sessions are parked, not hidden.** A session on another machine that went two hours without a turn used to disappear from your screen even though it was still running. It now stays on screen, dimmed, and its tooltip says "parked". A session waiting on you is never parked. Codex and Grok sessions are never parked, because their files don't record when the last turn was.
- **New logo:** a spiderweb with the orb at its hub. It is on the app icon, the Windows installer and the tray.

## What's fixed

- **Messages are no longer typed into a dialog by mistake.** If a remote session was on a screen such as Claude Code's `/permissions` list instead of its prompt, a message sent from another machine was typed into that screen as keystrokes, and could change it. Orbweaver now reads the screen first. If the terminal isn't at its prompt, nothing is typed, and your chat panel tells you so. Question forms can now be answered from any chat panel, not only the one on the machine running the session.
- **Remote orbs come back after an upgrade.** After installing a new version, the link between your machines sometimes never came back up, because the old copy of the app still held the port. It now keeps retrying in the background until the port frees up. Its log file used to stop being written once it reached 1 MB. It now rotates instead.
- **One unreadable folder can no longer freeze the link between your machines.** Building the list of slash commands read folders from disk while the link waited for it, and a folder macOS wouldn't let it open stalled the whole link. That list is now built in the background.
- **Every Claude Code profile is offered to your other machines.** Sessions running under a profile you added in **Settings → Claude Code** used to be missing on your other machines.
- **Claude Code sessions started by OpenClaw follow your OpenClaw settings.** An agent's heartbeat no longer shows up as an extra orb when you've set heartbeats to hidden, and an agent is never drawn twice.
- **Orbweaver on macOS no longer quits when a helper process times out.** It was sometimes killed right after a command it ran took too long. Child processes are now stopped in a way that can't take Orbweaver down too.
- **The remote chat panel no longer gets stuck on "fetching".** A crash in the chat panel left it showing "fetching" with no new messages until you reopened it.

## Upgrading

**Install 1.0.4 by hand, the usual way. Releases after this one can be installed from the update notice.** 1.0.3 doesn't have the updater, and the updater won't install anything older than 1.0.4.

- **macOS:** as with every upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** if your other machines or OpenClaw stop connecting. After later automatic updates, Orbweaver tells you which permissions macOS reset and opens the Local Network pane for you.
- **Install 1.0.4 on every machine you link together.** Parked sessions and the slash-command list only appear when the machine running the session also has 1.0.4.

## Known limitations

- Commands run *by* the Claude Code CLI itself, such as `/compact`, custom commands and skills, can't be run in cloud sessions, Claude Desktop Remote Control sessions or background jobs. The CLI only accepts them from its own trusted client. Those sessions offer only the commands that can run.
- On iTerm2, Terminal.app, kitty, WezTerm and Windows console windows, Orbweaver can't read the screen. There, the typing guard only goes by whether the session says it is waiting for you. Sessions in tmux get the full check.
- We have seen the folder that froze the link, but we don't know yet whether macOS privacy controls on a locked screen or an iCloud placeholder file caused it. The fix doesn't depend on which.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Orbweaver-1.0.4-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Orbweaver-1.0.4-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `Orbweaver-1.0.4-win-x64-setup.exe` |

The `OrbweaverSpeech-*.zip` files are the optional neural speech engine. The app downloads the one it needs, so you don't need to.
